transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, yeah, thank you. I guess I'm mostly here because... well, my sleep has just been really bad lately. It's getting kind of unreliable. Even when I'm completely exhausted at night, I just lie there. My mind sort of gets stuck on work stuff—like sales forecasts or things going on with my team. And then I end up waking up around 3 or 4 in the morning, and I just can't get my brain to shut off again. So... yeah, that's why I came in.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially around the same time your sleep problems started?
No, not really. I mean, I don't think so. I'm just tired mostly. I still do the things I normally do... I just wish I could sleep better.
Do you find yourself feeling unusually worried or tense, especially around the time you're trying to fall asleep?

Um, I guess so. Yeah. It's just... most days, my mind sort of jumps around a lot. Like, I'll start thinking about whether we're going to hit the launch numbers, and then I'm worrying if someone on my team is about to quit. And then it just spirals into, you know, the mortgage, or a client renewal. It just... it feels like every small delay is going to turn into something major. So, yeah, it's hard to relax.
Do you notice any physical symptoms, like restlessness, muscle tension, or feeling on edge, especially when you're trying to relax or fall asleep?

I suppose so, yeah. I just... I feel kind of wound up most of the time. Like I'm sitting in a pipeline review, even if I'm just at home trying to eat dinner. And my shoulders... they just stay tight. It doesn't really matter what I do, I just can't seem to get them to relax.
Have these sleep difficulties happened even during times when you weren’t particularly stressed or worried about work or other responsibilities?
I don't know... I guess I haven't really noticed. It just feels like there's always something going on, so... I'm not sure.
Can you remember a time when your sleep was better, even if everything else in your life was about the same?

Um... not recently, no. I guess... it's just been building up for a while. Ever since they did a reorganization in the sales division... that was about thirteen months ago. I haven't really slept well since then.
Have you noticed any nights where your sleep was better, even if just for a few days, when you weren't feeling particularly stressed about work or other responsibilities?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really keep track of it like that. It just all kind of blends together, I guess.
Do you find it hard to control your worries, even when you try not to focus on them?

Um... yeah, I guess. I try to stop. I'll tell myself, like... 'Brenda, you've done the plan, just let it go.' But... I don't know. Five minutes later, I'm just back in another loop. I check off one concern, and... three more just pop up. So... yeah.
Do you ever feel anxious or have trouble settling your mind even during the day, when you’re not trying to sleep?

Um... yeah. Most days, actually. My mind just sort of... jumps around. Like, I'll be thinking about whether we'll hit the launch numbers... and then suddenly I'm worrying if someone on my team is about to quit. Then it's... I don't know, the mortgage, or a client renewal. It just... it feels like every small delay could turn into something major. So... yeah. It's during the day, too.
Can you recall a time when you weren’t particularly stressed about work or other responsibilities, and if so, did your anxiety or sleep difficulties still bother you then?

Um... I'm not really sure. I mean... it feels like I've been stressed for a while now. I guess... it's been getting worse since they reorganized the sales division. That was... maybe thirteen months ago? So... I don't really remember a time before that right now.
Can you think of a time in the past when you weren’t feeling particularly stressed or worried about anything, and if so, did you still have trouble sleeping or feeling anxious during that time?
Um... like I just said, I really don't remember. It feels like there's always been something going on for a while now. So... no. I can't really think of a time like that.
